meta.plant_name: Kennedy International Airport cogeneration power station

units.notes: No new owner is reported. No document I found names a different company holding this plant.

qa.recommendation: Keep Calpine Corp as the owner for now. Check again if a newer filing names a Constellation entity as the plant holder.
qa.note: The EIA-860 annual table for 2024 still lists Calpine Corp as owner of the three generators at this plant, with KIAC Partners as the operating utility. A New York air permit renewal names KIAC Partners as the permit holder at the Calpine JFK Energy Center. I found no dated document that renames or merges the company holding the plant. A change of parent from Calpine to Constellation is not an owner change for this field. Also, a search result said Calpine holds a 50 percent general partner interest in KIAC Partners, which may mean the plant is jointly held. I could not confirm the other partner or any share split.
